hero.subtitle: Security Researcher & Security Intern @ UptoSkills
hero.description: Passionate about uncovering vulnerabilities and building secure systems. Currently focused on advanced penetration testing and automated malware analysis.

paragraphs: I am a dedicated cybersecurity professional with a strong foundation in manual web application testing and vulnerability assessment. My approach combines rigorous analytical thinking with hands-on technical expertise to secure digital assets and report critical security flaws.
Through my work at Cybrito, I aim to contribute to the security community by developing open-source security utilities and publishing technical writeups on real-world vulnerabilities.
